verdict.rationale: Phaser Studio ships a first-party Game Agent at phaser.io/agent that takes plain-language game requests. Its hosted MCP server lets you "describe what you want in plain language and your agent calls the tools for you", with example commands such as adding a double-jump or making gravity stronger. The Phaser Editor also documents an MCP server with 40+ tools for Claude Desktop, Cursor and Copilot, handling natural-language edits like creating particle emitters or reorganising layers, and a runtime probe confirms the hosted MCP endpoint is live. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language control quality, in-depth documentation beyond marketing pages on what commands and tools are supported.
